clue.text: One has a cap of extra length

parts.note: extra means more, as in 'more milk'

explanation.surface: Something comes with a cap made extra long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One has a cap' reads like a hat-wearer, but it means a mushroom, whose top is called its cap.
explanation.definitionFit: This edible fungus has a honeycombed cap on a stalk, so it is a thing that has a cap.

clue.text: Don't get axed, but leave tournament early

definitions.meaning: to avoid being cut down by an axe, the blow passing you by
in golf, players failing to reach the qualifying score after two rounds go home

explanation.walkthrough: In golf, the cut removes weaker players halfway through a tournament.
explanation.definitionFit: Avoiding the axe's stroke and failing golf's halfway qualifying score are both described by this phrase.

clue.text: Drama school lacks a measure of dangerous activity

indicators.note: lacks means the drama school's name loses the letter A

parts.note: RADA is the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, a London drama school

explanation.surface: A drama school lacks any measure of danger.
explanation.walkthrough: RADA, the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art in London, loses an A. 'dangerous activity' is radioactivity, a pun.
explanation.definitionFit: The rad is a unit of absorbed radiation dose, measuring exposure to dangerous radioactivity.

clue.text: Shine, wanting head to pay attention

indicators.note: wanting head means the word for shine loses its first letter

parts.note: to glisten is to shine

explanation.surface: A shiny but headless thing has to pay attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting head' takes the G off GLISTEN.
explanation.definitionFit: To listen is to give heed with the ears, the same as paying attention.

clue.text: Sudden recall of felon, initially to administer flogging

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word felon

parts.note: to lash someone's back is to administer a flogging

explanation.surface: A criminal's first job is to whip someone, in a sudden memory.
explanation.walkthrough: The flogging phrase is read as two words, LASH (whip) and BACK (where the lashes land), after F from 'felon, initially'.
explanation.definitionFit: A flashback is a sudden vivid memory of a past event, so a sudden recall.

clue.text: Not hungry, pig beginning to dine on this basis?

parts.note: someone not hungry is full
a boar is a male pig

indicators.note: beginning asks for the first letter of the word dine

explanation.surface: A pig who is not hungry starts to dine anyway.
explanation.walkthrough: In hotels, full board is the arrangement in which all meals are included, so one dines on this basis.
explanation.definitionFit: Full board is a hotel tariff basis that includes breakfast, lunch and dinner.

clue.text: I may contribute to Forest in local derby

indicators.note: in shows the tree sits inside the words local derby

explanation.surface: A player contributes to Nottingham Forest in a local derby.
explanation.walkthrough: Forest suggests Nottingham Forest football club and a local derby match; here a forest is made of trees, and this tree is one.
explanation.definitionFit: This tree can be one of the many that make up a forest, contributing to it.

clue.text: Statuesque queen, endlessly solitary person

indicators.note: endlessly means the word for a solitary loses its last letter

parts.note: a solitary, as a noun, is a recluse or hermit
one means a person, as in 'one should know better'

explanation.surface: A stately queen leads a lonely life.
explanation.walkthrough: In Shakespeare's The Winter's Tale, Queen Hermione is presented as a statue that comes to life, hence 'Statuesque'.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's queen in The Winter's Tale poses as a statue before being revealed alive.

clue.text: Spat, finding cent in change

indicators.note: in places the cent letter inside the word for change

parts.note: an alteration is a change

explanation.surface: A row breaks out over a cent in someone's change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spat' is a noun, a petty quarrel, not the past tense of spit.
explanation.definitionFit: A spat is a short quarrel, and an altercation is a noisy argument.

clue.text: I'm fired to bring death shortly to knight

indicators.note: shortly means the word for bring death is cut short by one letter

parts.note: to kill is to bring death
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: Someone fired for killing a knight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I'm fired' sounds like being sacked; pottery is fired in this oven.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiln is the oven in which pottery and bricks are fired, so the object that is fired in.

clue.text: Leaves food next to plate

parts.note: leaves here are lettuce leaves, and the food served beside the main plate is a side dish of them

explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' looks like a verb (food leaving), but it is salad leaves, and 'next to plate' marks a dish served at the side.
explanation.definitionFit: A small dish of salad greens served beside the main course sits next to the plate.

clue.text: One eats honey — value line

parts.note: to value something is to rate it

explanation.surface: A honey-eater is judged against a set line of value.
explanation.walkthrough: The ratel is the honey badger, an African and Asian animal known for raiding bees' nests.
explanation.definitionFit: The ratel, or honey badger, famously raids beehives for honey and larvae, so it is one that eats honey.

clue.text: After about hour breaks in pub, runner lacking velocity to be City defender

indicators.note: After at the head of the clue puts the pub and runner pieces after the first part
about means the taming word goes round the hour letter

parts.note: to break in a horse is to tame it, so breaks in gives tames
a bar is a pub

indicators.note: lacking tells us to remove the letter for velocity

parts.note: in crosswords a runner is often a river, which runs
V is the physics symbol for velocity

explanation.surface: Someone back from the pub an hour later is tired and slow but must defend the city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' at the start orders the pieces: the pub and the slowed runner come after the first part. The Thames Barrier is the flood barrier protecting London, the City.
explanation.definitionFit: The movable flood gates across London's river protect the capital from tidal surges, a defender of the City.

clue.text: Why battery's failed in town

indicators.note: failed signals the letters break down and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone asks why their battery died in town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'failed' rearranges WHY and BATTERYS. Aberystwyth is a seaside university town in Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Aberystwyth is a coastal Welsh town on Cardigan Bay.

clue.text: Moved left, getting end of glove to catch -— it's shelled

parts.note: went means moved, as in went away

indicators.note: end of asks for the last letter of the word glove

parts.note: to trap is to catch

explanation.surface: Someone moves left with a glove to make a catch.
explanation.walkthrough: A wentletrap is a sea snail with a spiralled white shell; 'shelled' suggests bombarded.
explanation.definitionFit: The wentletrap is a marine snail with a tall spiral shell, so a creature that is shelled.

clue.text: Regular occurrence, almost

indicators.note: almost means drop the final letter of the word for occurrence

parts.note: an occurrence is an event

explanation.surface: Something happens almost regularly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' removes the last letter, T, from EVENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Even and regular are synonyms for something uniform and steady, as in an even pace.

clue.text: Wife's previous address?

parts.note: address is read not as a home but as the form by which she was called before marrying

explanation.walkthrough: 'address' suggests where she used to live; it means how she was addressed, her surname before marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A married woman's surname before the wedding is how people formerly addressed her.

clue.text: Give pounds to old sculptor

parts.note: to donate is to give
L stands for a pound, doubled for the plural as with pp for pages

explanation.surface: Someone gives money to an elderly sculptor.
explanation.walkthrough: Donatello was a fifteenth-century Florentine Renaissance sculptor.
explanation.definitionFit: Donatello was a celebrated Italian sculptor of the early Renaissance, maker of the bronze David.

clue.text: Head of state washed up before time

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word for washed is read from bottom to top

parts.note: laved is an old word for washed
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A leader of a country is finished before their time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns LAVED to give DEVAL. 'Washed up' looks like a phrase meaning finished. Eamon de Valera was President of Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Eamon de Valera served as Taoiseach and then President of Ireland, a head of state.

clue.text: Hard guy in line out punched in back of head

indicators.note: punched in means a letter is driven inside the jumbled letters
out signals the letters of guy in line are put out of order
back of asks for the last letter of the word head

explanation.surface: A man in a queue is punched in the back of the head, hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges GUYINLINE, and 'punched in' drives D (the 'back of head') into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Unyielding means firm and not giving way under pressure, which is one sense of hard.

clue.text: Qualified to hold a command

indicators.note: to hold means the word for qualified holds the letter A inside it

parts.note: someone fit for a job is qualified for it

explanation.surface: Qualified people are entitled to give a command.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to hold' puts A inside FIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiat is an authoritative decree or order, which is a command.

clue.text: Obtained part of tree — its top

parts.note: a bough is a main branch, part of a tree
its refers to the tree, and the top letter of tree is T

explanation.surface: Someone got a branch from a tree, right from its top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'its' points back to 'tree', so its top is the first letter, T.
explanation.definitionFit: Bought means acquired by paying, which is one way to have obtained something.

clue.text: Passing through room reached from landing

definitions.text: Passing through room reached from landing

parts.words: Passing through room reached from landing
parts.note: landing is not on a staircase but an aircraft touching down, and passing through means in transit to another flight

explanation.walkthrough: The room and landing suggest a house; it is an airport waiting area for passengers changing planes.
explanation.definitionFit: At airports, passengers who land and wait to change flights without entering the country use this waiting area.

clue.text: With face of stone, walk into room

indicators.note: face of asks for the front letter of the word stone

parts.note: to pace is to walk

explanation.surface: Someone stony-faced walks into a room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'room' is not a chamber but space, as in room to move.
explanation.definitionFit: Room and space both mean available area, as in no room to swing a cat.

clue.text: Peer into future and, after a second, howl

indicators.note: after places the howl word following the letter for a second

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for a second
to cry is to howl

explanation.surface: A fortune-teller looks ahead and, a moment later, howls.
explanation.walkthrough: To scry is to foretell the future by gazing into a crystal ball or similar surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To scry is to gaze into a crystal or mirror to see the future, peering into it.

clue.text: Bonnie companion to Flower of Scotland

definitions.meaning: Bonnie Parker's partner in crime in the 1930s American outlaw pair
a flower is a crossword river (it flows), here the river through Glasgow

explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower of Scotland' is also the unofficial Scottish anthem, but here a flower is something that flows.
explanation.definitionFit: Clyde Barrow was Bonnie's partner, and the Clyde is a major river flowing through Glasgow.

clue.text: River creature, almost exhausted, has to fish around

indicators.note: almost means the final letter of the word for exhausted is dropped

parts.note: all in is an informal way of saying exhausted

indicators.note: around means the fish's name wraps round the word to

parts.note: a gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: A tired creature in the river has to go fishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exhausted' is the informal 'all in'; 'River creature' tempts a fish, but the fish is in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: This large reptile lives in rivers and swamps, so it is a creature of the river.

clue.text: Dancing exploit

definitions.meaning: a style of dancing with metal-plated shoes clicking on the floor
to draw on or use a resource, as with a barrel or phone line

explanation.walkthrough: 'exploit' is a verb, not a noun meaning a feat.
explanation.definitionFit: Tap is a dance style, and to tap a resource is to exploit it.

clue.text: What's heard from men on the pull is hooey — have got upset

definitions.text: What's heard from men on the pull

indicators.note: got upset signals the letters of hooey and have are overturned into a new order

explanation.surface: A complaint that something is nonsense, with people getting upset about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the pull' suggests chatting people up; it means sailors hauling on a rope.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the traditional chant of sailors heaving on ropes together, heard from men pulling.

clue.text: What pregnant bitch is waiting for: a little more

definitions.text: What pregnant bitch is waiting for
definitions.meaning: a pregnant dog waits to give birth to puppies
a small extra amount added, as in refilling a glass

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition splits the answer as TO PUP: a pregnant bitch (female dog) is waiting to have pups.
explanation.definitionFit: A small additional amount poured or added to refill something is a little more.
